finding.summary: The validation workflow generated the v325 freeze locally, but its publish step tested file existence after git reset --hard. Because git reset --hard does not remove untracked files, the locally generated freeze remained present and was incorrectly interpreted as already present in origin/main. No commit containing metapleno-v325-validation-freeze.json is present in the main history before validation.
notAffected: the two development survivors were selected mechanically from the persisted Stage 1 artifact
no 2023-2024 blind OOS file was opened by v325

validation.reason: The exact freeze was not demonstrably public before validation read. A negative result may be retained as descriptive evidence but cannot be upgraded into a clean confirmatory test.

decision.next: Archive v325. Preserve 2023-2024 as untouched by this family. Fix publication proof before any future validation family.
